name: doom-face
description: The DOOM status bar face in Claude Code's footer: it reacts to what the session does, and its health follows the context window

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: How much the face moves: full (every animation), calm (slower, no flickers or jolts) or still (one face per state)

size.title: Size
size.description: The face's size in the footer: small (4x2 cells), medium (6x3) or large (8x4)
